title: News to Prelims question: EPFO / SFIO

q.headline: EPFO asks the Corporate Affairs ministry to refer a company case to SFIO
q.question: In this news, which statement is correct?
options: EPFO works under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs
SFIO works under the Ministry of Labour
SFIO got statutory status under the Companies Act, 2013
EPFO was created by the Companies Act, 2013

rules.v: Corporate Affairs ministry. Statutory status under the Companies Act, 2013.
Labour ministry. Created under the EPF & MP Act, 1952.

sources: EPFO asked MCA to refer the case to SFIO: the420.in/?p=143913 (also legacyias.com/?p=186930, 19 Nov 2026 page)
SFIO under MCA, statutory status via Companies Act 2013 s.211: mca.gov.in/MinistryV2/sfio.html ; ies.gov.in arthapedia SFIO
EPFO under Ministry of Labour and Employment; CBT statutory body under EPF & MP Act 1952: epfindia.gov.in/site_en/AboutEPFO.php, Our_Board.php
